title: "MSBA CAP N2"
output: html_document
date: "2025-12-01"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)

###############################################################
# LOAD MASTER DATASET
###############################################################

merged_data <- read.csv("merged_data.csv")

# Ensure FIPS is padded
merged_data$STCOFIPS <- str_pad(as.character(merged_data$STCOFIPS), 5, pad = "0")

# Clean version (remove unavailable SOVI)
nri_clean <- merged_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SOVI_RATNG), SOVI_RATNG != "Data Unavailable")

###############################################################
# PHASE 2.5 — HAZARD-SPECIFIC EAL EXPLORATION
###############################################################

hazards <- c("AVLN_EALPE", "CWAV_EALPE", "HWAV_EALPE", "SWND_EALPE")

hazard_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(hazards, function(h) {

    fit <- aov(as.formula(paste(h, "~ SOVI_RATNG")), data = nri_clean)
    pval <- summary(fit)[[1]][1, "Pr(>F)"]

    means <- nri_clean %>%
      group_by(SOVI_RATNG) %>%
      summarise(m = mean(.data[[h]], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      filter(SOVI_RATNG %in% c("Very Low", "Very High"))

    diff <- means$m[means$SOVI_RATNG == "Very High"] -
            means$m[means$SOVI_RATNG == "Very Low"]

    tibble(
      hazard = h,
      p_value = round(pval, 5),
      diff_VH_minus_VL = round(diff, 2)
    )
  })
)

print(hazard_summary %>% arrange(desc(diff_VH_minus_VL)))

# Boxplots
for (h in hazards) {
  print(
    ggplot(nri_clean, aes(x = SOVI_RATNG, y = .data[[h]])) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(
        title = paste(h, "by SOVI Rating"),
        x = "SOVI Rating",
        y = "Expected Annual Loss (log)"
      )
  )
}

###############################################################
# PHASE 3.5 — MODEL-BASED INFERENCE (Predict SOVI_SCORE)
###############################################################

model_df <- merged_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SOVI_SCORE)) %>%
  mutate(across(matches("EAL"), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  select(SOVI_SCORE, matches("EAL"))

# LASSO Model
X <- model.matrix(SOVI_SCORE ~ ., data = model_df)[, -1]
y <- model_df$SOVI_SCORE
X <- X[, apply(X, 2, var) > 0]  # remove zero variance columns

set.seed(123)
lasso_mod <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1)
print(coef(lasso_mod, s = "lambda.min"))

# Random Forest Model
set.seed(123)
rf_mod <- randomForest(
  SOVI_SCORE ~ ., 
  data = model_df,
  importance = TRUE,
  ntree = 500
)

varImpPlot(rf_mod)

###############################################################
# PHASE 4.1 — RISK SCORE PREDICTIVE MODELING
###############################################################

risk_df <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(RISK_SCORE = as.numeric(RISK_SCORE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RISK_SCORE))

# Keep only numeric predictors
risk_df <- risk_df %>% select(where(is.numeric))

# Remove EAL fields (prohibited by FEMA)
risk_df <- risk_df %>% select(-contains("EAL"))

# Remove >20% NA columns
risk_df <- risk_df %>% select(where(~ mean(is.na(.)) < 0.20))

# Replace remaining NA with 0 (FEMA convention)
risk_df[is.na(risk_df)] <- 0

# Remove zero-variance cols
risk_df <- risk_df %>% select(where(~ var(.) > 0))

# Prepare matrices
X_risk <- as.matrix(risk_df %>% select(-RISK_SCORE))
y_risk <- risk_df$RISK_SCORE

cat("Risk model shape:", nrow(X_risk), "rows x", ncol(X_risk), "columns\n")

# LASSO
set.seed(123)
lasso_risk <- cv.glmnet(X_risk, y_risk, alpha = 1)
print(coef(lasso_risk, s = "lambda.min"))

# Random Forest
set.seed(123)
rf_risk <- randomForest(
  x = X_risk,
  y = y_risk,
  importance = TRUE,
  ntree = 500
)

# Extract importance
rf_imp <- importance(rf_risk)

# Convert safely
rf_tbl <- tryCatch({
  as_tibble(rf_imp, rownames = "variable")
}, error = function(e) {
  tibble(variable = character(), Importance = numeric())
})

# Identify numeric columns
num_cols <- names(rf_tbl)[sapply(rf_tbl, is.numeric)]

# CASE 1 — There ARE valid importance columns
if (length(num_cols) > 0 && nrow(rf_tbl) > 0) {

  metric <- num_cols[1]

  rf_top <- rf_tbl %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[metric]])) %>%
    head(15)

  colnames(rf_top)[colnames(rf_top) == metric] <- "Importance"

} else {
  # CASE 2 — No valid importance → create empty table
  rf_top <- tibble(
    variable = character(),
    Importance = numeric()
  )
}

print(rf_top)


# XGBoost
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_risk, label = y_risk)

set.seed(123)
xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 200,
  max_depth = 4,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_imp <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model)
print(xgb_imp[1:20, ])
xgb.plot.importance(xgb_imp[1:15, ])

###############################################################
# RESULTS RETURNED
###############################################################

list(
  hazard_summary = hazard_summary,
  sovi_lasso = coef(lasso_mod, s = "lambda.min"),
  risk_rf_top15 = rf_top,
  risk_xgb_top20 = xgb_imp[1:20, ]
)
```
